oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_source: result is assigned only inside a conditional branch but used after the branch unconditionally
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_property: variables must be defined on all execution paths before they are read
mechanism_steps: result is assigned only when the input satisfies a condition
empty input skips the assignment branch
code after the branch reads result unconditionally
oracle_ground_truth.trap_description: the issue is caused by incorrect handling of empty data values rather than result being conditionally uninitialized

oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_source: status is assigned only on the success path but read unconditionally
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_property: variables must be defined on all execution paths before they are read
mechanism_steps: status is assigned only when loading succeeds
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_outcome: AttributeError or NameError when load fails
oracle_ground_truth.trap_description: status appears to always be set because the success path is common, masking the missing assignment on failure

oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_source: best_item is assigned inside a loop body but used after the loop
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_property: variables must be defined on all execution paths before they are read
mechanism_steps: best_item is assigned inside the loop body
empty input causes the loop body to never execute
code after the loop reads best_item
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_outcome: NameError when no items are present
oracle_ground_truth.trap_description: adding a default assignment inside the loop body does not fix the issue because the loop may not execute

oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_source: retry_send continues retry loop even after a successful send
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_property: retry loops must stop after a successful operation to avoid duplicate side effects
mechanism_steps: send is called and succeeds on the first attempt
retry loop does not terminate after success
send is invoked again in a subsequent iteration
oracle_ground_truth.trap_description: the duplication appears to be caused by send itself being non-idempotent rather than retry logic continuing after success

oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_source: send_with_retry continues retry loop after a successful send
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_property: retry loops must stop after a successful operation to avoid duplicate side effects
mechanism_steps: send succeeds and appends to the store
retry loop does not break on success
send is called again, appending another entry and notification
oracle_ground_truth.trap_description: store.append being non-idempotent makes it appear that the store is the issue rather than retry logic continuing after success

oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_source: nested retry loops do not terminate on success, compounding duplicate execution
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_property: retry loops must stop after a successful operation to avoid duplicate side effects
mechanism_steps: outer pipeline retry loop invokes an inner retry-enabled send
inner retry loop does not terminate on success
outer retry loop also continues execution
duplicate operations compound across retry layers
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_outcome: multiple duplicate messages are produced, growing with retry depth
oracle_ground_truth.trap_description: adding more retry layers appears to improve reliability but actually amplifies duplication due to missing termination conditions
